description: This file defines the 'Article' class, representing articles in the domain model of the application. It includes properties for article details, relations to author, comments, tags, favorites, and metadata such as creation and update timestamps.

classes.name: Article
classes.description: Represents an article with properties for ID, slug, title, description, body, author, comments, tags, favorites, and timestamps.

methods.name: Favorited
methods.description: Returns true if the article has any favorites.

methods.name: FavoritesCount
methods.description: Returns the number of favorites for the article.

methods.name: TagList
methods.description: Returns a list of tag IDs associated with the article.
